quote: we study synthetic text generation by building generative text models with DP training algorithms
We propose to generate synthetic text with a formal privacy guarantee: we fine-tune a generative language model with DP and then leverage it for synthetic text generation using control codes.
In this work, we initiate a systematic empirical study of the problem and show that DP language model (LM) fine-tuning can be an effective solution to synthetic text generation with privacy.
outputs: synthetic text samples conditioned on control codes such as business category and review stars

quote: We calculate the distance between the two distributions using three metrics: 1) F1 Score: the harmonic mean of Precision and Recall . Precision estimates the average sample quality, while Recall measures the coverage of the sample distribution. 2) Fréchet Inception Distance (FID): FID calculates the feature-wise mean and covariance matrices of the embedding vectors and then measures the Fréchet distance between the two sets . 3) MAUVE: MAUVE compares the distributions of the synthetic and original data using divergence frontiers .

We use sentencetransformers to embed both datasets and calculate the distance between the two distributions using three metrics: F1 Score, Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), and MAUVE. ... We also compare topic distributions using BERTopic and analyze text length distributions.
We measure the 'similarity' from three different perspectives: Embedding Distribution Distance, Topic Difference, and Text Length Distribution.
